items.source: Compatible with GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini, GPT-4 Turbo and all GPT-3.5 Turbo models newer than gpt-3.5-turbo-1106. The JSON_OBJECT type enables JSON mode, which guarantees the message the model generates is valid JSON. items.source: The OpenAI User Message API can incorporate a list of base64-encoded audio files with the message. Spring AI’s Message interface facilitates multimodal AI models by introducing the Media type. This type encompasses data and details regarding media attachments in messages, utilizing Spring’s org.springframework.util.MimeType and a org.springframework.core.io.Resource for the raw media data. Currently, OpenAI support only the following media types: audio/mp3 and audio/wav.
items.translation: OpenAI 的用户消息 API可以在消息中嵌入一组 base64 编码的音频文件。 Spring AI 的Message接口通过引入Media类型，为多模态 AI 模型提供了支持。 该类型涵盖了消息中媒体附件的数据和详细信息，利用 Spring 的org.springframework.util.MimeType以及org.springframework.core.io.Resource来处理原始媒体数据。 目前，OpenAI 仅支持以下媒体类型：audio/mp3和audio/wav。

items.source: When using GPT-5 models such as gpt-5, gpt-5-mini, and gpt-5-nano, the temperature parameter is not supported. These models are optimized for reasoning and do not use temperature. Specifying a temperature value will result in an error. In contrast, conversational models like gpt-5-chat do support the temperature parameter.
items.translation: 在使用 GPT-5 系列模型（如 gpt-5、gpt-5-mini 和 gpt-5-nano）时，不支持 temperature 参数。 这些模型专为推理任务优化，不使用温度参数。 若指定了温度值，将导致错误。 相比之下，对话类模型（如 gpt-5-chat）则支持 temperature 参数。

items.source: Controls which (if any) function is called by the model. none means the model will not call a function and instead generates a message. auto means the model can pick between generating a message or calling a function. Specifying a particular function via {"type: "function", "function": {"name": "my_function"}} forces the model to call that function. none is the default when no functions are present. auto is the default if functions are present.
items.translation: 控制模型调用哪个（如果有）函数。none 表示模型不会调用函数，而是生成一条消息。auto 表示模型可以在生成消息或调用函数之间进行选择。通过指定特定函数 {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "my_function"}} 会强制模型调用该函数。如果没有定义函数，默认值为 none；如果定义了函数，默认值为 auto。

items.source: For streaming calls, the okhttp.requests span fires and is recorded in the registry, the timer is recorded in MeterRegistry, and traceparent is still propagated on the outbound request — but the span is not nested under the chat-model span. This is because the OpenAI SDK’s async streaming implementation hops onto ForkJoinPool.commonPool() before invoking Spring AI’s HTTP client, dropping the calling thread’s observation context at that boundary. Spring AI cannot recover the context from within its HTTP-client wrapper.
items.translation: 对于流式调用，`okhttp.requests` 跨度会触发并在注册表中记录，计时器记录在 `MeterRegistry` 中，且 `traceparent` 仍会在出站请求中传播——但该跨度不会嵌套在 chat-model 跨度之下。 这是因为 OpenAI SDK 的异步流式实现会在调用 Spring AI 的 HTTP 客户端之前跳转到 `ForkJoinPool.commonPool()`，从而在该边界处丢失了调用线程的观察上下文。 Spring AI 无法从其 HTTP 客户端包装器内部恢复该上下文。

items.source: When using a local Docker Model Runner that exposes an OpenAI-compatible API, you may need to append /v1 to your base URL if the server expects it. For example: spring.ai.openai.chat.base-url=http://localhost:12434/engines/v1 instead of localhost:12434/engines.
items.translation: 在使用暴露 OpenAI 兼容 API 的本地 Docker Model Runner 时，如果服务器需要该路径，您可能需要在基础 URL 后追加 /v1。例如：spring.ai.openai.chat.base-url=http://localhost:12434/engines/v1，而不是 localhost:12434/engines。

items.source: User-controlled tool execution — use DefaultToolCallingManager directly when you need full control over the loop (for example, when combining tool calling with direct ChatModel access).
items.translation: 用户控制的工具执行 — 当您需要对循环进行完全控制时（例如，在将工具调用与直接访问 ChatModel 相结合的情况下），请直接使用 DefaultToolCallingManager。

items.source: Use this pattern when you need direct access to the ChatModel API and want full control over the tool-call loop. Invoke ChatModel directly without ToolCallingAdvisor; check for tool calls yourself and drive the loop using ToolCallingManager.
items.translation: 当您需要直接访问ChatModel API 并希望完全控制工具调用循环时，请使用此模式。 直接调用ChatModel而无需使用ToolCallingAdvisor；自行检查工具调用情况，并使用ToolCallingManager驱动循环。

items.source: The OpenAiChatModel implements the ChatModel and StreamingChatModel and uses the [low-level-api] to connect to the OpenAI service.
items.translation: OpenAiChatModel 实现了 ChatModel 和 StreamingChatModel，并使用 [低层 API] 连接到 OpenAI 服务。

items.source: Spring AI can additionally bind OkHttp connection-pool gauges (okhttp.pool.connection.count with state=active|idle and client.kind=sync|async) to the application’s MeterRegistry. These are secondary telemetry — useful for capacity tuning but not required for tracing or per-request latency — so they’re disabled by default.
items.translation: Spring AI 还可以将 OkHttp 连接池指标（okhttp.pool.connection.count，其中 state=active|idle 和 client.kind=sync|async）绑定到应用程序的 MeterRegistry。 这些属于次要遥测数据——可用于容量调优，但并非追踪或请求级延迟所必需——因此默认处于禁用状态。

items.source: Spring AI uses the official openai-java SDK under the hood and configures its HTTP transport with a custom OkHttp client built by SpringAiOpenAiHttpClient.Builder. You can intercept that builder before the underlying OkHttpClient is created by exposing one or more OpenAiHttpClientBuilderCustomizer beans. Each customizer receives the same builder used by every OpenAI model (chat, embedding, image, audio, moderation), so the customization applies uniformly.
items.translation: Spring AI 在底层使用官方的 openai-java SDK，并通过由 SpringAiOpenAiHttpClient.Builder 构建的自定义 OkHttp 客户端配置其 HTTP 传输层。 您可以通过暴露一个或多个 OpenAiHttpClientBuilderCustomizer Bean 来拦截该 Builder，在底层 OkHttpClient 创建之前进行定制。 每个定制器都会接收到 OpenAI 所有模型（包括聊天、嵌入、图像、音频和审核）所使用的相同 Builder，因此定制效果将统一应用。

items.source: Starting from version 2.0.0-M5, Spring AI uses the official openai-java SDK under the hood for all OpenAI models. The transition is expected to be seamless and there are no breaking changes for existing users of the OpenAI API properties and builders. If you find any issues, please report them to us at Spring AI GitHub Issues.
items.translation: 自版本2.0.0-M5起，Spring AI 在底层使用官方的openai-java SDK 来处理所有 OpenAI 模型。此次过渡预计将无缝进行，且对现有使用 OpenAI API 属性和构建器的用户而言不会有任何破坏性变更。如果您发现任何问题，请通过Spring AI GitHub Issues向我们报告。

items.source: The maximum number of tokens to generate in the chat completion. The total length of input tokens and generated tokens is limited by the model’s context length. Use for non-reasoning models (e.g., gpt-4o, gpt-3.5-turbo). Cannot be used with reasoning models (e.g., o1, o3, o4-mini series). Mutually exclusive with maxCompletionTokens - setting both will result in an API error.
items.translation: 生成聊天补全时允许生成的最大 token 数量。输入 token 和生成 token 的总长度受模型上下文长度的限制。适用于非推理模型（例如 gpt-4o、gpt-3.5-turbo）。不能与推理模型一起使用（例如 o1、o3、o4-mini 系列）。与 maxCompletionTokens 互斥——同时设置两者将导致 API 错误。

items.source: An upper bound for the number of tokens that can be generated for a completion, including visible output tokens and reasoning tokens. Required for reasoning models (e.g., o1, o3, o4-mini series). Cannot be used with non-reasoning models (e.g., gpt-4o, gpt-3.5-turbo). Mutually exclusive with maxTokens - setting both will result in an API error.
items.translation: 完成时可生成的 token 数量的上限，包括可见输出 token 和推理 token。推理模型必需（例如 o1、o3、o4-mini 系列）。不可与非推理模型配合使用（例如 gpt-4o、gpt-3.5-turbo）。与 maxTokens 互斥——同时设置两者将导致 API 错误。

items.source: Output types that you would like the model to generate for this request. Most models are capable of generating text, which is the default. The gpt-audio model can also be used to generate audio. To request that this model generate both text and audio responses, you can use: text, audio. Not supported for streaming.
items.translation: 您希望模型为此请求生成的输出类型。大多数模型能够生成文本，这是默认选项。gpt-audio 模型还可以用于生成音频。若要请求该模型同时生成文本和音频响应，您可以使用：text、audio。此功能不支持流式传输。

items.source: Audio parameters for the audio generation. Required when audio output is requested with output-modalities: audio. Requires the gpt-audio model and is is not supported for streaming completions.
items.translation: 音频生成参数。当请求的音频输出模态包含 `output-modalities` 中的 `audio` 时，此参数为必需项。该功能需要 `gpt-audio` 模型支持，且不支持流式完成。

items.source: Optional HTTP headers to be added to the chat completion request. To override the api-key you need to use an Authorization header key, and you have to prefix the key value with the Bearer prefix.
items.translation: 可选的 HTTP 头，将添加到聊天完成请求中。若要覆盖 `api-key`，需要使用 `Authorization` 头键，并且必须在密钥值前添加 `Bearer` 前缀。

items.source: ChatClient with ToolCallingAdvisor — the recommended approach for most use cases. ToolCallingAdvisor is automatically registered when tools are present and manages the tool-call loop transparently.
items.translation: 使用 ToolCallingAdvisor 的 ChatClient——这是大多数用例的推荐方法。当存在工具时，ToolCallingAdvisor 会自动注册并透明地管理工具调用循环。

items.source: You have to specify an audio modality in the OpenAiChatOptions to generate audio output. The AudioParameters class provides the voice and audio format for the audio output.
items.translation: 要在 `OpenAiChatOptions` 中指定 `audio` 模态以生成音频输出。 `AudioParameters` 类提供了音频输出的声音和音频格式。

items.source: OpenAI provides custom Structured Outputs APIs that ensure your model generates responses conforming strictly to your provided JSON Schema. In addition to the existing Spring AI model-agnostic Structured Output Converter, these APIs offer enhanced control and precision.
items.translation: OpenAI 提供自定义的结构化输出API，确保您的模型生成的响应严格符合您提供的JSON Schema。 除了现有的 Spring AI 模型无关的结构化输出转换器外，这些 API 还提供了更高级的控制能力和更高的精度。

items.source: HTTP layer. An okhttp.requests observation wraps every HTTP attempt to the OpenAI API, carrying HTTP method, URI, status code, and exception tags. Each request also propagates traceparent on the wire to any downstream services (AI gateways, OpenAI-compatible inference servers, proxies).
items.translation: HTTP 层。okhttp.requests 观察对象封装了针对 OpenAI API 的每一次 HTTP 请求，包含 HTTP 方法、URI、状态码和异常标签。每个请求还会在传输过程中传播 traceparent 头，以便下游服务（如 AI 网关、OpenAI 兼容推理服务器或代理）能够进行追踪。

items.source: If you need to correlate streaming HTTP spans with their parent chat-model span in your tracing UI, filter by span name okhttp.requests with host api.openai.com and join to the corresponding gen_ai.client.operation span by trace ID or timestamp range. Built-in parent linkage for streaming is being pursued upstream in the OpenAI Java SDK.
items.translation: 如果您需要在追踪 UI 中将流式 HTTP 跨度与其父级 chat-model 跨度进行关联，请筛选跨度名称为 okhttp.requests 且主机为 api.openai.com 的记录，然后通过跟踪 ID 或时间戳范围将其与对应的 gen_ai.client.operation 跨度连接。 OpenAI Java SDK 正在上游开发流式的内置父级关联功能。

items.source: Also note that the extraBody Map is intentionally flattened into the top-level of the JSON request during serialization. So setting extraBody(Map.of("custom_flag", true)) results in {"custom_flag": true} at the root of the JSON payload, matching the behavior of official SDKs.
items.translation: 此外，请注意在序列化过程中，`extraBody` Map 会被有意扁平化到 JSON 请求的顶层。因此，设置 `extraBody(Map.of("custom_flag", true))` 会导致 `"custom_flag": true` 出现在 JSON 负载的根节点处，这与官方 SDK 的行为一致。

items.source: Fallback behavior: When reasoning_content is not provided by the server (e.g., official OpenAI Chat Completions), the reasoningContent metadata field will be an empty string.
items.translation: 回退行为：当服务器未提供reasoning_content（例如官方 OpenAI 聊天补全服务）时，reasoningContent元数据字段将是一个空字符串。

items.source: The sampling temperature to use that controls the apparent creativity of generated completions. Higher values will make output more random while lower values will make results more focused and deterministic. It is not recommended to modify temperature and top_p for the same completions request as the interaction of these two settings is difficult to predict.
items.translation: 用于控制生成补全结果表面创造力的采样温度。较高的值会使输出更加随机，而较低的值则使结果更加聚焦和确定性。不建议对同一补全请求同时修改 temperature 和 top_p，因为这两个设置的交互作用难以预测。

items.source: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered. We generally recommend altering this or temperature but not both.
items.translation: 另一种替代温度采样的方法是核采样（nucleus sampling），其中模型会考虑概率质量在top_p范围内的 token 结果。例如，0.1 表示仅考虑占据前 10% 概率质量的 token。我们通常建议调整此参数或temperature，但不要同时调整两者。

items.source: A cache key used by OpenAI to optimize cache hit rates for similar requests. Improves latency and reduces costs. Replaces the deprecated user field for caching purposes. Learn more.
items.translation: OpenAI 用于优化相似请求缓存命中率的缓存键。可改善延迟并降低成本，已取代用于缓存目的的废弃 `user` 字段。了解更多。

items.source: A stable identifier to help OpenAI detect users violating usage policies. Should be a hashed value (e.g., hashed username or email). Replaces the deprecated user field for safety tracking. Learn more.
items.translation: 一个稳定的标识符，用于帮助 OpenAI 检测违反使用策略的用户。应为一个哈希值（例如哈希后的用户名或电子邮件）。该字段替代了已弃用的 user 字段，以支持安全追踪。了解更多。

items.source: On start-up, the default options can be configured with the OpenAiChatModel(api, options) constructor or the spring.ai.openai.chat.* properties.

items.source: You can register custom Java functions with the OpenAiChatModel and have the OpenAI model intelligently choose to output a JSON object containing arguments to call one or many of the registered functions. This is a powerful technique to connect the LLM capabilities with external tools and APIs. Read more about Tool Calling.

items.source: The extraBody parameter is intended for use with OpenAI-compatible servers, not the official OpenAI API. The official OpenAI API applies strict validation and will return an HTTP 400 error ("Unknown parameter: 'extra_body'") if unrecognized fields are encountered.

`extraBody` 参数专为与 OpenAI 兼容的服务器使用而设计，不适用于官方 OpenAI API。

items.source: If you are communicating with the official OpenAI API, you should never populate the extraBody parameter.
items.translation: 如果您正在与官方 OpenAI API 通信，则绝不应填充 extraBody 参数。

items.source: The extraBody parameter accepts any Map<String, Object>, allowing you to pass whatever parameters your target server supports. Spring AI does not validate these parameters—they are passed directly to the server. This design provides maximum flexibility for working with diverse OpenAI-compatible implementations.
items.translation:

items.source: Although this is optional for JSON Schema, OpenAI mandates required fields for the structured response to function correctly. Kotlin reflection is used to infer which property are required or not based on the nullability of types and default values of parameters, so for most use case @get:JsonProperty(required = true) is not needed. @get:JsonProperty(value = "custom_name") can be useful to customize the property name. Make sure to generate the annotation on the related getters with this @get: syntax, see related documentation.
items.translation: 尽管对于 JSON Schema 而言这是可选的，但 OpenAI 强制要求结构化响应中必须包含必需字段以确保其正常工作。Kotlin 反射会根据类型的可空性以及参数的默认值来推断哪些属性是必需的，因此对于大多数用例，无需使用 @get:JsonProperty(required = true)。@get:JsonProperty(value = "custom_name") 可用于自定义属性名称。请确保在相关的 getter 上生成带有此 @get: 语法的注解，请参阅 相关文档。
